description: Image Description: The image depicts a serene and vibrant garden scene, characterized by lush greenery and colorful flowers. In the foreground, there are several traditional Japanese parasols, known as "wagasa," which are open and tilted at various angles, adding a decorative and cultural element to the scene. The parasols are pinkish in color and are supported by wooden handles.
